title: LPC company profile (demo)
implementation_note: WordCraft (the vendored WASM Word editor) loads a static index.html in an iframe with no observed postMessage/param channel to pre-load a document, and its vendor bundle is not even present in this checkout (fetched separately). Integration is DOWNLOAD-ONLY: the .docx is generated fresh client-side (docx lib) and offered as a download; the user opens it themselves via WordCraft's own Open-file control. No engine code was touched or guessed at.
expected_asset: n/a - verified by pih-office-samples.test.ts (valid zip container, non-empty)

title: PI Holding / ERPCons ecosystem overview (demo)
implementation_note: Same DeckCraft iframe constraint as Word/Excel - download-only, same reasoning. Unblocked by adding `pptxgenjs` (new dependency; not previously in repo) and generating 4 slides (cover, ecosystem diagram via shapes/text only, highlights, closing) - no images embedded, so pptxgenjs's image-parsing code path (its `image-size` transitive dep has an open high-severity DoS advisory for malformed JXL/HEIF/ICNS files) is never exercised by this generator. Needs a human to actually open the downloaded file in real PowerPoint and in DeckCraft to confirm it renders as intended - only automated structural checks (valid zip, 4 slide parts, expected text present) have been run.
expected_asset: n/a - verified by pih-office-samples.test.ts (valid pptx zip container, exactly 4 slide parts, diagram slide contains expected labels)
